v1.6.3g (25 March 2023) |feed_title = Tower Rebalances |previous_update = [[v1.6.2|Valentines 2023 Update]] |next_update = [[v1.6.4]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.6.3''' is the forty-ninth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 17th of February 2023. The initial release only contained a few bug fixes and skin changes, but weeks later multiple balance changes and upgrade description corrections were introduced. Weirdly, there was no update log in the game at the update's initial release, though there was one posted in the official Tower Defense Simulator Discord server. An update log was made later when [[v1.6.4]] update released, however, it was a changelog for the '''v1.6.3e''' version specifically. This version encompassed eight updates, the main v1.6.3 update (released 17 February 2023) and seven minor updates, the v1.6.3a (released 18 February 2023), v1.6.3b (released 1 March 2023), v1.6.3c (released 9 March 2023), v1.6.3d (released 14 March 2023), v1.6.3e (released 21 March 2023), v1.6.3f (released 22 March 2023) and v1.6.3g (released 25 March 2023). ==Changes & Bugfixes== *New faces for the {{Color|ColdFront|Silent}} [[Sniper]], {{Color|ColdFront|Frost Hunter}} [[Scout]]/[[Golden Scout]], {{Color|ColdFront|Brisk}} [[Commander]] and {{Color|ColdFront|Stranded}} [[Medic]] skins. *Fixed {{Color|ColdFront|Stranded}} [[Medic]] skin not having some of its accessories. *Corrected [[Lovely Crate]] and [[Cold Front Crate]] ads in the store listing their price as {{Coins|5,000}} instead of {{Coins|4,000}}. *Fixed opening inventory while opening a crate. *Fixed players sometimes not being able to join the intermission lobby. *Fixed [[Gift Box]] showing rewards you have already claimed. *Fixed not being able to claim old rewards. *Fixed "''Daily Tower Skins''", "''Daily Emote''" and [[Daily Store]] timers text not being lined up properly, making icons cover up the text.
